summary: Health insurance add-ons can cover expenses such as consumables, OPD treatment and hospitalisation-related costs, but each rider can increase your premium. Experts explain which add-ons may be useful and what policyholders should check before buying them.

title: Invesco MF reopens 3 international FoFs for investments: ₹10 lakh daily limit, SIP & STP rules investors must know
summary: Invesco Mutual Fund will resume fresh subscriptions in three overseas Fund of Funds from September 28, 2026, allowing lumpsum investments, switch-ins and new SIP, STP and IDCW Transfer Plan registrations. Investors face a ₹10 lakh daily limit per PAN, including existing systematic-plan instalments.

title: New EPF wage ceiling: What changes for your PF, pension and insurance
summary: The revised EPFO ceiling of ₹25,000 a month, effective 17 September, will affect employees differently depending on their existing PF status, wages and contribution structure.

title: ST certificate cancelled 40 years later: Retired employee loses claim to full pension benefits, what Madras HC said
summary: The Madras HC upheld the cancellation of an employee's ST certificate after authorities found that he belonged to the Urali Gounder community. The court also refused full pension and other terminal benefits, ruling that retirement does not prevent verification of an old community certificate.

title: Missed ₹431 on credit card bill, charged ₹30,000 interest; know the consequences of not making the full payment
summary: A Reddit user faced heavy finance charges after missing a credit card payment by just ₹431. Here's all you need to know about the consequences of not paying credit card bills by the due date.

title: Digital gold may come under RBI, SEBI oversight: What physical gold backing could mean for investors
summary: The government is considering bringing digital gold under RBI and SEBI oversight, with a proposal for every digital unit to be backed by equivalent physical gold. The move could bring stricter rules on vault holdings, audits and investor protection.

title: Rs 23,000 crore outflows! Is the September FII rout indicating a worse end to 2026?
